name: Saint Athanasius
biography: Described as 'the hero of this period,' the lifelong champion of Nicene orthodoxy against Arianism, Bishop of Alexandria from 328, repeatedly exiled for his zeal but immensely popular in Egypt. Reconciled ecclesiastics to the monastic movement, helped establish the rule that monks should be priests, and introduced monasticism into the West while in Rome in 339.
